features.name: GL Allocations
features.description: A new feature that allows distributing or allocating cost and revenue using fixed allocation types (predefined percentages), variable allocation types (based on statistical accounts), or inherit from parent type (using existing GL accounts with dynamic allocation keys).

features.name: Fixed Allocation Type
features.description: Allows you to define how you share a line item by assigning predefined percentages to dimensions, such as splitting rent per department based on predetermined allocation percentages.

features.name: Variable Allocation Type
features.description: Allows dynamic allocation based on statistical accounts and dimensions, enabling allocation keys that change over time, such as using employee headcount or office space to distribute costs.

features.name: Inherit from Parent Allocation Type
features.description: Allows selecting any existing GL account and allocating it using a specified allocation key without needing to create a dedicated allocation account, saving setup time for accounts that are used infrequently.
caveats: Account can only be reused for cost splits based on number of employees

features.name: Allocation Accounts with General Journals
features.description: Allocation accounts work in general journals, allowing allocation of revenue and cost by selecting an allocation account and preview the split before posting.

features.name: Allocation Accounts with Deferrals
features.description: Allocation accounts integrate with the deferral feature, allowing costs to be both allocated to dimensions and spread across multiple periods in a single transaction.

features.name: Allocation Accounts with Purchase Documents
features.description: Allocation accounts can be used in purchase invoices to allocate invoice amounts across dimensions and GL accounts at the time of entry.

features.name: Manual Adjustment of Allocations
features.description: Users can modify the proposed allocation distribution before posting, including changing amounts, GL accounts, dimensions, and even deleting lines to customize the final posting.

features.name: Allocation Account Setup UI
features.description: The allocation account setup page provides a share UI pattern that allows users to easily adjust allocation percentages while automatically ensuring they sum to 100%, and can calculate percentages from whole numbers.
caveats: System ensures percentages always add to 100%

features.name: Statistical Accounts
features.description: A feature that holds non-financial numerical data used for analysis and reporting, such as employee headcount, which can be used as allocation keys for GL allocations.

features.name: Decimal Precision in Allocation Calculations
features.description: The system calculates allocation percentages to five decimal places internally for accuracy, even though the UI displays whole percents. Amount rounding is applied when allocating to specific GL lines.
caveats: Users can override calculated percentages manually
Calculations use up to five decimals internally while UI shows whole percents
Amount rounding applied when allocating to specific GL lines

features.name: Dimension Assignment in Allocations
features.description: Users can define dimensions for allocation lines. When GL lines are created from a main GL line, the specified dimensions are automatically assigned and will override existing dimensions on the allocation line.
caveats: Defined dimensions take priority and override line-specific dimensions

features.name: Allocation Testing Tool
features.description: A testing feature that shows how allocations will distribute amounts and displays the precision being used. Users can see approximate amounts that will be posted before actually posting the allocation.

features.name: Variable Allocation Accounts
features.description: Allocation accounts with variable percentages calculated dynamically based on GL account balances or statistical accounts. Can use options like balance at date, fiscal year, week, quarter, or previous year to determine percentages.
caveats: Requires selecting calculation method (balance at date, fiscal year, week, quarter, or previous year)

features.name: Global Dimension Filtering for Allocations
features.description: Users can filter allocation lines by global dimensions. For example, filter destination accounts to specific departments (administration, production, sales) to control which GL lines receive allocated amounts.
caveats: Filtering applied to global dimensions only

features.name: General Journal Account Management Integration
features.description: A codeunit that handles all logic integrating allocation accounts with General Journal functionality, managing the posting process and GL line creation.

features.name: Sales and Purchase Allocation Account Management
features.description: Two specialized codeunits that integrate allocation accounts with sales and purchase management processes, handling allocation logic specific to each domain.

features.name: Allocation Account Integration Events
features.description: Two integration events for extending allocation account functionality: OnBeforeCreateGeneralJournalLine for splitting custom quantities or amounts, and OnBeforeVerify for compatibility checks.
caveats: Custom quantities or amounts require subscription to OnBeforeCreateGeneralJournalLine
OnBeforeVerify must be used to throw errors for incompatible functionality
